full_judgment: 21. In Rikhu Dev, Chela Bawa Haarjug Dass vs Som Dass, AIR 1975 SC 2159, the appellant instituted the suit claiming as Mahant-in-charge of the Shiromoni Dera the right to manage the properties attached to the Dera at Landeke and prayed for recovery of possession of the Dera. The trial Court decreed the suit and in the appellate Court the decree was reversed. An appeal was preferred by the appellant to the High Court and while the appeal was pending Som Dass, the defendant, died. No application was made by the appellant to bring on record his legal representatives within the prescribed period. After about 9 months of death an application was made for impleading the deceased's Chela Shiam Dass in the appeal. The High Court rejected the application and abated the appeal. The Supreme Court granted leave to the appellant to prosecute the appeal. The Supreme Court observed:
